stem:
The table shows the high temperatures and the numbers of snow cones sold at a snack bar on seven days.

Snow Cone Sales

| High Temperature (°F) | Number Sold |
|------------------------|-------------|
| 92                     | 25          |
| 85                     | 30          |
| 90                     | 28          |
| 87                     | 22          |
| 95                     | 32          |
| 93                     | 30          |
| 92                     | 40          |

Which scatterplot best represents the data in the table?

options.label: C
options.text: (Scatterplot with points not matching table data exactly)

options.label: D
options.text: (Scatterplot with points not matching table data exactly)

notes: Scatterplots A and B appear visually similar and match the given data points closely. C and D do not match well. The problem asks to select the best scatterplot that represents the data.
